gloss: to demote; to downgrade; to relegate

definitions.gloss: to demote; to downgrade; to relegate
definitions.explanation: To lower someone or something in rank, status, or grade. Used in workplace hierarchies, sports leagues, and classification systems.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{課長|かちょう}→課長：01075_kachou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{降格|こうかく}された。
examples.english: He was demoted from department head to section chief.

examples.japanese: ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{二部|にぶ}⟦リーグ→リーグ：11600_riigu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{降格|こうかく}した。
examples.english: The team was relegated to the second division.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦{不振|ふしん}→不振：07771_fushin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{降格|こうかく}→降格：04688_koukaku⟧⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: He received a demotion due to poor performance.

notes:
Used both transitively (to demote someone) and intransitively (to be demoted / to drop in rank). In sports, equivalent to English "relegation" when a team drops to a lower division.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{降格|こうかく}→降格：04688_koukaku⟧⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧: demotion (as disciplinary action)
- ⟦{降格|こうかく}→降格：04688_koukaku⟧⟦{人事|じんじ}→人事：00126_jinji⟧: demotion in personnel decisions
- {二軍|にぐん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{降格|こうかく}する: to be sent down to the minor league
- ⟦{降格|こうかく}→降格：04688_koukaku⟧⟦{圏|けん}→圏：21183_ken⟧: relegation zone (in sports leagues)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{昇格|しょうかく}→昇格：08369_shoukaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be promoted in rank — the antonym of ⟦{降格|こうかく}→降格：04688_koukaku⟧, meaning to move up in status or division
- ⟦{左遷|させん}→左遷：06831_sasen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be transferred to a lesser position — implies a sideways move to a less desirable post as a de facto punishment, while ⟦{降格|こうかく}→降格：04688_koukaku⟧ is an explicit rank reduction
- ⟦{格下|かくさ}げ→格下げ：20848_kakusage⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to downgrade — more general, can apply to ratings, classifications, and evaluations, not just personnel
